Bluffton's Latin American Kitchen

Tio's opened its Buckwalter Place restaurant in Bluffton in February 2021, bringing the food of Mexico, Cuba, Honduras, Spain and Central and South America to the mainland. Chef Lynden Zuniga's kitchen makes salsa, queso and tortilla chips in house every day, and the bar hand squeezes limes daily for every margarita.

Stop in for happy hour, bring the family for dinner, or plan a private party with our event coordinator. From Old Town to Sun City, Tio's is Bluffton's spot for tacos, fajitas and a great margarita.
